definitions.explanation: Arranging items for people to see, especially in stores or museums.

examples.japanese: {商品|しょうひん}を{棚|たな}に{陳列|ちんれつ}する。
examples.english: To display products on the shelves.

examples.japanese: {美術館|びじゅつかん}に{貴重|きちょう}な{絵画|かいが}が{陳列|ちんれつ}されている。
examples.english: Valuable paintings are displayed in the museum.

examples.japanese: {新作|しんさく}の{陳列|ちんれつ}が{終|お}わったら、{店|みせ}を{開|あ}けましょう。
examples.english: Let's open the store once we're done displaying the new products.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{商品|しょうひん}{陳列|ちんれつ} - product display
・{陳列|ちんれつ}{棚|だな} - display shelf
・{陳列|ちんれつ}ケース - display case
・{陳列|ちんれつ}{台|だい} - display stand
・{陳列|ちんれつ}{室|しつ} - showroom

COMPARISON:
・{陳列|ちんれつ} - display (formal, for products/exhibits)
・{展示|てんじ} - exhibition (art, demonstrations)
・{飾|かざ}る - to decorate/display (general term)
・ディスプレイ - display (loanword, often for visual merchandising)
